XenotypeDef.label: titan
XenotypeDef.description: Titans are stony giants mass-produced to reclaim deathworlds. Their strength and armored bodies let them labor in poisonous conditions that would kill ordinary workers. Each is devoted to a particular task, pursuing it without need for recreation but learning painfully slowly at anything that does not engage their passions. Some develop petrification, an incurable disease that slowly turns their living tissue to stone.\n\nReclamation companies grow titan work crews in vats, each batch assigned to a different stage of making a dead world habitable. They have raised settlements in burning deserts, frozen tundras, and poisonous wastelands. They say little about their work and seem to care even less about its purpose. In abandoned industrial settlements, some still maintain walls and machines for employers who vanished generations ago. Storms howl, companies collapse, and the titans keep working.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Titans are stony giants made to reclaim deathworlds, each devoted to a particular task. They are hard to hurt and need no recreation, but learn painfully slowly outside their passions. They can also develop incurable petrification.
